messages:
maya: Heads-up — telemetry is showing multiple short-lived availability drops for our transient GPU pools in us-west1 over the last 90m. T4 pool had a couple of 1–3min blips, and a100-pool-2 lost capacity for ~6m around 08:17 UTC. :eyes:
ben: saw that too. graphs look spikier than usual. any signs it's infra vs cloud-side preemptions?
sasha: Cloud-side. I correlated with provider preempt events and they line up. but the weird bit is the interruption_rate metric is high for a few minutes then back to normal — noisy but frequent.
maya: exact numbers: interruption_rate(T4) peaked at 0.12 for 2m, then dropped. a100-pool-2 had available_capacity drop to 0.09 of target for ~6m. SLO alert didn't fire but tail latency increased ~9%.
raj: can you paste the promql you used? want to reproduce in dashboard.
maya: sure — here's the promql for the interruption spike window:
```
max_over_time(transient_gpu_preemptions_total{pool=~"t4.*"}[5m]) / increase(transient_gpu_total_capacity[5m])
```
carla: for available capacity I used a rolling window: available_gpus / desired_capacity, and smoothing with a 3m avg to ignore micro-fluctuations.
ben: sounds like alerts need hysteresis. right now we alert on instant > 0.1 which is sensitive. propose new composite alert:
```
- alert: TransientPoolDegradedComposite
  expr: (increase(transient_gpu_preemptions_total[5m]) / max(1, increase(transient_gpu_total_capacity[5m])) > 0.06) and (avg_over_time(available_capacity_ratio[5m]) < 0.15)
  for: 6m
```
maya: +1 to composite. Also add severity: page if sustained >15m, otherwise post to #eng-infra for ops review.
sasha: One more improvement — tie the alert to SLO impact estimation. We can add an annotation that calculates estimated SLO error budget burn using recent latency delta. Example annotation: `estimated_slo_burn: (tail_latency_95 / slo_target - 1) * traffic_pct`
ops-bot: Incident hint: When TransientPoolDegradedComposite fires, check `autoscaler_events` and `provider_preempt_logs` in the same window. Runbook step #2: consider quick pool failover to dedicated if sustained. :white_check_mark:
maya: I'll open a runbook PR with the hysteresis + composite rule and include the annotation. tagging @carla to review dashboard panels — we should show both raw events and smoothed signals side-by-side.
carla: will do. I'll add a small panel that overlays `increase(transient_gpu_preemptions_total[5m])` and `avg_over_time(available_capacity_ratio[5m])` and a vertical stripe for autoscaler scale events.
raj: small ask — can we mute the flapping alerts coming from single-instance churn? maybe only trigger if at least 3 distinct instances preempted in the window.
ben: good idea. update the expr to use `count_values(instance, ...)` or `count_over_time` helper.
maya: adding that: `count_over_time(preempt_events{pool="a100-pool-2"}[6m]) >= 3` — combine with the composite.
telemetry-bot: FYI we pushed a new metric `pool_distinct_preempt_count` this morning; graphs available at https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/infra/transient-gpu.
sasha: nice — use that instead of hacky counts.
carla: I'll update dashboard and attach screenshots to the PR. also adding a brief note to ops-runbook about when to escalate to Dedicated fallback.
ben: ops question — cost tradeoff: if we fallback to dedicated for the pool for 1h does that blow our budget? need an estimate.
maya: rough calc: dedicated an hour for a pool ~ 3x on-demand cost but avoids tail latency. put a knob in the runbook: fallback threshold default off, enable per-customer when SLO impact > 10% for 30m.
raj: I'll add a short terraform alert config draft in the PR. can someone open the Jira?
maya: created INF-8421 to track: runbook + alert + dashboard + PR reviews. assigned to carla & sasha.
ben: thanks. once PR is up, can we stage the alert to staging Grafana first for a day to ensure it's not noisy?
carla: yep. will also add a mute window for the maintenance window between 02:00–03:00 UTC — that region sometimes autoscaler-rebalances then.
maya: perfect. closing loop: next actions — carla update dashboard, sasha review composite rule, maya PR runbook + alert, raj terraform patch, ben cost estimate. will follow up in INF-8421. :thumbsup:
